title: Nvidia Has $21 Billion SpaceX Stake, $30 Billion in Intel Shares
description: Nvidia Corp. on Friday disclosed a nearly $21 billion stake in Elon Musk’s SpaceX and a $30 billion one in Intel Corp.

title: Anthropic Revenue Ahead of IPO Surges Over 14-Fold in Second Quarter
description: Anthropic PBC is telling prospective investors its second-quarter revenue jumped at least 14-fold versus the same period a year ago, according to documents seen by Bloomberg News.

title: Amazon’s New User Agreement Seeks to Curb Class-Action Suits
description: Amazon.com Inc. reintroduced a clause in its user agreement that seeks to prevent shoppers from filing class-action lawsuits against the online retailer, inserting a legal buffer between itself and plaintiffs attorneys that it removed five years ago.
